Aim & RQs: assess how grad students use AI tools for literature review (prevalence, specific use-cases and workflows, perceived benefits/risks, effects on search breadth/rigor, and variation by discipline and experience); key RQs: Who uses which AI tools for which tasks, how do they integrate outputs into review work, and what are observable impacts on search behavior and citation/coverage decisions?  
Design & justification: mixed-methods, pragmatically optimized for a 6-week window — a cross-sectional online survey (quantitative breadth using items adapted from your two surveys and the grant) + targeted semi-structured interviews (n≈12–18) for process detail + optional artifact comparison (small subsample of literature-review drafts with/without AI) to triangulate self-report with textual evidence.  
Main tasks / work packages: (1) synthesize the shared-drive materials into survey and interview guides and artifact protocols, (2) prepare consent/IRB summary and recruitment text, (3) build & pilot the survey, (4) deploy survey and recruit respondents, (5) conduct interviews and collect artifacts, (6) clean/analyze quantitative data and code qualitative data, (7) integrate results and draft the methods/results plan for the conference submission.  
Sequence & milestones (6 weeks): Week 1 — finalize instruments, pilot, and file IRB/exemption summary; Weeks 2–3 — survey fielding and initial recruitment (target N≈150 across departments) + schedule interviews; Week 4 — close survey, run preliminary quantitative summaries, conduct interviews (12–18); Week 5 — artifact collection and mixed-methods integration, begin writing methods/results; Week 6 — finalize analyses, draft and polish conference submission, submit.  
Feasibility & next step: this is doable using departmental lists and course contacts and by reusing measures from the shared materials, but will require rapid piloting and attention to consent/de-identification for artifacts; I will prepare the full submission-ready methods section, survey instrument, interview guide, recruitment text, and analysis plan within 5 days unless you want different priorities.
